description: Fallow quality baseline. Counters may shrink but not grow; averageMaintainability may rise but not drop. Regenerate with `npm run check:quality -- --update` (commit the diff in the same PR that moves the metric). The do-date increment (PR #75) lowered averageMaintainability 91.8->91.7 — the reviewed reason is recorded in docs/Gaps.md GAP-74 (that entry's complexFunctions 13->15 bump was retired by a later refactor, per the same GAP). The Task Detail increment (PR #76) lowered it 91.7->91.6: adding the real async useTaskDetail composable (own MI 87.7, in line with its siblings useTaskSchedule 88.0 / useTaskReorderCommit 86.6 / useTaskDisplay 86.2 — not a factoring problem) pulls the repo-wide average down ~0.1 at this rounding edge; every counter metric (complexFunctions, cloneGroups, criticalComplexity, deadCode) stayed at/under baseline, single-sourcing shared field-reflection into utils/taskMutations.ts rather than duplicating. A later Task Detail follow-up (PR #76, Codex round 27) lowered it 91.6->91.5: onOpenTask gained a required P1 guard — it must NOT open Task Detail while the row's own write is in flight, or a detail save/delete races the row write (both replace the whole document; a late field write can recreate a file Detail just deleted). The guard is one added conditional in useTaskActions.ts (already a documented LOC hotspot); a concise if/else-if form did not recover the ~0.05 rounding-edge drop, and the fix is a data-integrity requirement, so the floor moves rather than contorting the code. Every counter metric stayed at/under baseline. The screen-capture source-picker increment (phase 2 task 9) lowered it 91.5->91.4: the first frontend slice of screen capture adds five files — stores/screenCapture.ts (MI 90.0), components/ScreenSourcePicker.vue (86.3), components/ScreenAudioPicker.vue (89.1) and the two suites (88.8 / 89.7) — every one inside fallow's "good" band and in line with its siblings (ImportVaultPicker.vue 83.7, stores/capture.ts 81.3), so this is not a factoring problem: a 210-file AVERAGE falls whenever normal new code lands below the current mean, and the exact mean here is 91.4493 against a 91.45 rounding edge. Splitting the larger suite into two files was tried and recovered 0.0003 — the metric is not line-count-driven — so the floor moves rather than contorting new code to chase a rounding edge. Every counter metric stayed at or under baseline (deadCodeIssues 2, complexFunctions 13, criticalComplexity 4, cloneGroups 0, circularDependencies 0): no new complex function, clone, dead export or cycle is masked. The region-selection overlay increment (phase 3 task 4) raised deadCodeIssues 2->3: `src/types.ts` gained the `RegionSelection` DTO (`select_capture_region`'s reply shape) as spec 5.2 groundwork, ahead of the frontend consumer that reads it. Nothing in this task's own code (RegionRoot.vue, which only produces RegionPick) uses it, and no consumer can exist yet — the Rust command it documents is phase 3 task 5, still unbuilt. Phase 3 task 7 (already specced) wires ScreenSourcePicker's Region tab to `invoke<RegionSelection | null>("select_capture_region", …)`, which resolves this entry back to 2 in that task's own PR. averageMaintainability and every other counter stayed at baseline.
